summary: Minerva Neurosciences filed an 8-K reporting entry into an at-the-market (ATM) offering agreement with Leerink Partners LLC. The company may sell up to $75 million of common stock over time through the agent, who receives a 3% commission. The offering is conducted under an existing S-3 shelf registration statement. No shares are required to be sold, and either party may terminate at will. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a special situation event. There is no premium, fixed price, or structural change; it is an ordinary shelf takedown mechanism.
